On the table

Photos from guests in the tavern’s Google listing.

A fish tavern by the bay

Glaros is a traditional fish tavern on Intiras Gkanti street, near Limassol port and a few metres from the beach. Under the blue awning, guests look out over the bay. Guests on Google describe it as family-run, with many locals at the tables and fresh fish that you can choose yourself.

Many order the fish meze: dish after dish of prawns, calamari, mussels, octopus and small fish. The grilled octopus is praised again and again. There is plenty of free parking; for the evening it is best to reserve.
